title: OPENINGBALANCEMONTH in the first month of the Date table is BLANK
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", OPENINGBALANCEMONTH ( [Sales], 'Date'[Date] ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2023, 1, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2023, 1, 31 ) )

source.quote: Therefore, the result is BLANK for an expression that uses the dates, for example a sum of sales.
source.supports: no date before the first month

derivation: January 2023 is the first month of the Date table: there is no previous month end, the date filter is empty and the sum of sales is BLANK.
notes: The type of the BLANK column is not asserted.
